summary: Keep the tr6 identity cookie on TaskRabbit login and read Chrome cookies through the www host.
reason: TaskRabbit now sets session, XSRF-TOKEN, and tr6 host-only on www.taskrabbit.com. A bare-domain Chrome read missed them, and session plus XSRF-TOKEN alone returns 401; tr6 carries the logged-in identity.
validated_outcome: Against a live logged-in session, /api/v3/account.json returned 401 with session + XSRF-TOKEN and 200 once tr6 was added. The new test fails before the change and passes after; the full module suite passes.
